title: Egreen Quanta: Quantum-Inspired Fuel Consumption Prediction and Green Fleet Optimization

dataset.split_protocol: Chronological forward temporal: 60% train (104,384), 20% validation (34,794), 20% test (34,796)

baseline_model.architecture: LightGBM regressor on full 14-feature engineering set

quantum_inspired_candidate.architecture: QIEA feature selection + QPSO hyperparameter optimization + LightGBM

statistical_comparison.verdict: Competitive with classical GA control (statistical parity, p=0.684); QIEA maintains +44.7% population bit-entropy diversity.

uncertainty_quantification.methodology: Split Conformal Prediction (absolute residual non-conformity score)
uncertainty_quantification.scientific_statement: QI-C1 produced narrower conformal intervals than MODEL-REAL-04 under the evaluated test protocol (31.17% narrower), while maintaining empirical coverage (93.56%) above the nominal 90% level.

out_of_distribution_guard.qualification: Synthetic set contains multiple OOD severity tiers. Modest and moderate extrapolations are intentionally permitted through with uncertainty inflation, while severe OOD is intercepted with 96.55% recall at primary threshold and 100.0% at warning threshold.

software_safety.scientific_statement: All evaluated invalid-input, edge-case, and injected-failure scenarios passed the defined software safety tests.

alternative_fuels_methodology.status: Thermodynamic scenario simulation (invariant shaft work energy basis)
alternative_fuels_methodology.equation: E_shaft = P_B * t = m_f * LHV_f * eta_f
alternative_fuels_methodology.emissions_accounting: Strict separation of Well-to-Tank (WtT), Tank-to-Wake (TtW), and Well-to-Wake (WtW)

fleet_optimization.scientific_statement: The penalized objective incorporates a large schedule-feasibility penalty; therefore its optimum must not be interpreted as the pure physical fuel minimum.

negative_research_finding.model: Matrix Product States (MPS) direct tensor-network prediction
negative_research_finding.finding: Tested and found unviable under evaluated training configuration due to optimization divergence; honestly documented and excluded from serving path.
